name: Undirect
tagline: Stop pages taking your click in Safari, and see everywhere a page tried to send you.
description:
Some pages lay an invisible layer over themselves to catch the click you meant for something else. Undirect is a Safari extension for Mac, iPhone and iPad that clears it, and lists everywhere a page tried to send you.

Pop networks do not wait to be clicked. They lay a transparent layer over the page and take the next press. They build a link and click it themselves. They rewrite the link under your finger between the press and the release. They open a blank tab and rewrite the address of the one you were reading. Undirect watches for those shapes and undoes them.

## Features

- The invisible layer goes before your press lands, so the click reaches what you aimed at.
- A link rewritten mid-click is put back, and you arrive where you meant to.
- A new window opens only when a site asks for one at a size, the way a sign-in does.
- Everywhere a page tried to send you is listed, whether or not it was stopped.
- Each destination can be allowed or blocked, on that site alone or everywhere. A destination with no rule follows a default you set.
- What is blocked everywhere becomes a content blocking rule, so the request never leaves your device.

## Where it fits

Undirect is for people who read, stream or browse in Safari and keep landing on a page they never chose. It guards the click itself, and pairs with the ad blocker you already use.

## Privacy and requirements

No account, no analytics, no server. The list of destinations lives in your browser, and the app reads it through a container on the same machine. Nothing leaves the device unless you press Report, which opens a prefilled issue you send yourself.

Undirect is a Safari extension. Switch it on in Safari, then press its toolbar button on each site you want guarded. The Mac app requires macOS 15 or later.

## Pricing

One purchase on the App Store covers iPhone, iPad and Mac. The source code is public under GPL-3.0.
